hook: Your 8-day trip just became 286 days, like Sunita Williams.
title: Her 8-Day Trip Lasted 286 Days in Space
description:
Sunita Williams launched on Boeing's Starliner in June 2024 for a trip planned to last about eight days. Starliner had problems and returned without her, so she came home in March 2025 after 286 days. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #SunitaWilliams #Space
